reviewer: Aftergraph deterministic semantic verifier v0.1 on isolated GitHub Actions runner

findings.summary: A client-only guard cannot eliminate instantaneous provider-side pricing or billing-semantic drift after the final documentation validation and before provider billing.
findings.disposition: Accepted as an external-provider limitation, not a local budget or authority bypass. Pricing/context evidence is checked before reservation and immediately before atomic transport claim; observable drift fails closed and post-claim automatic retry is prohibited.
